evals.prompt: We have a legacy Java EE 7 application running on WebLogic that we need to migrate to Spring Boot 3.x. The app has about 50 EJBs, uses JPA for persistence with Oracle DB, and has some JAX-RS REST endpoints. We want to containerize it and deploy to OpenShift. Can you create a migration plan?
evals.expected_output: Complete migration plan with spec.md analyzing current Java EE structure, design.md proposing Spring Boot architecture, tasks.md with detailed migration tasks including test generation, containerization, and deployment configs, and UserStory.md grouping work into deliverable stories

assertions.name: all_four_documents_generated
assertions.description: Verify that spec.md, design.md, tasks.md, and UserStory.md were all created

assertions.name: spec_has_code_examples
assertions.description: spec.md includes at least 2 concrete code examples showing current state patterns

assertions.name: design_addresses_ejb_migration
assertions.description: design.md specifically addresses how to migrate EJBs to Spring components

assertions.name: tasks_have_integration_hooks
assertions.description: tasks.md includes mig-test-gen, mig-containerize, and mig-deploy subtasks

assertions.name: tasks_are_actionable
assertions.description: Each task has specific, implementable subtasks with checkboxes (not vague TODOs)

assertions.name: userstory_links_to_tasks
assertions.description: UserStory.md references specific task groups from tasks.md

assertions.name: userstory_has_acceptance_criteria
assertions.description: Each user story includes testable acceptance criteria

assertions.name: addresses_openshift_deployment
assertions.description: Plan includes OpenShift-specific deployment considerations

evals.prompt: I need help planning a migration from a Rails monolith to Node.js microservices. The current app is about 80k lines of Ruby code with ActiveRecord models, background jobs using Sidekiq, and a PostgreSQL database. We're targeting Kubernetes deployment on AWS EKS. The team wants a phased approach, not big bang. Create a detailed migration roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Migration plan showing phased approach with spec.md documenting Rails architecture, design.md proposing microservice boundaries and Node.js stack, tasks.md breaking down phased migration with parallel run strategy, and UserStory.md organizing by business capability

assertions.name: all_four_documents_generated
assertions.description: Verify that spec.md, design.md, tasks.md, and UserStory.md were all created

assertions.name: design_proposes_phased_approach
assertions.description: design.md explicitly outlines a phased migration strategy (not big bang)

assertions.name: design_defines_microservice_boundaries
assertions.description: design.md proposes specific microservice boundaries and rationale

assertions.name: tasks_include_parallel_run_strategy
assertions.description: tasks.md addresses how old and new systems will run in parallel during migration

assertions.name: addresses_sidekiq_migration
assertions.description: Plan addresses how to migrate Sidekiq background jobs to Node.js equivalent

assertions.name: addresses_activerecord_to_orm
assertions.description: Plan addresses migrating ActiveRecord models to Node.js ORM (like Sequelize/TypeORM)

assertions.name: userstory_organized_by_phase
assertions.description: UserStory.md organizes stories by migration phase or business capability

assertions.name: eks_kubernetes_specifics
assertions.description: Plan includes AWS EKS and Kubernetes-specific deployment details

evals.prompt: Our company has a .NET Framework 4.8 application that needs to move to .NET 8 and containerize for Azure AKS deployment. The app uses WCF services, Entity Framework 6, and SQL Server. There are also some legacy ASMX web services we need to modernize to REST APIs. What's the migration plan?
evals.expected_output: Migration plan with spec.md analyzing .NET Framework dependencies and WCF usage, design.md showing modernization to .NET 8 with gRPC/REST, tasks.md covering WCF-to-gRPC migration, EF6-to-EF Core upgrade, containerization, and AKS deployment, UserStory.md organizing by service boundaries

assertions.name: all_four_documents_generated
assertions.description: Verify that spec.md, design.md, tasks.md, and UserStory.md were all created

assertions.name: addresses_wcf_migration
assertions.description: design.md proposes specific approach for migrating WCF services (gRPC, REST, or CoreWCF)

assertions.name: addresses_ef6_to_ef_core
assertions.description: Plan addresses upgrading Entity Framework 6 to EF Core with migration considerations

assertions.name: addresses_asmx_modernization
assertions.description: Plan includes strategy for modernizing ASMX web services to REST APIs

assertions.name: tasks_have_integration_hooks
assertions.description: tasks.md includes mig-test-gen, mig-containerize, and mig-deploy subtasks

assertions.name: aks_azure_specifics
assertions.description: Plan includes Azure AKS-specific deployment considerations

assertions.name: framework_to_net8_challenges
assertions.description: spec.md or design.md addresses breaking changes from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 8

assertions.name: userstory_has_dependencies
assertions.description: UserStory.md shows dependencies between stories (what must complete first)
